title: Step outside and find three different greens
detail: Leaves, moss, a door — anything counts.

title: Drink a full glass of water, slowly
detail: Pip says thank you, on behalf of your cells.

title: Send someone a "this made me think of you"
detail: A song, a meme, a memory. No reason needed.

title: Stretch like a cat who just woke up
detail: Arms, back, the big yawn. Commit to it.

title: Doodle the view from where you're sitting
detail: Ugly doodles are the best doodles.

title: Put on one song and actually listen
detail: No scrolling. Just the song.

title: Write down one thing you're quietly proud of
detail: Small wins are still wins.

title: Make your bed like a hotel would
detail: Future you will flop into it gratefully.

title: Go on a five-minute "nothing walk"
detail: No destination, no podcast. Just walk.

title: Text a friend a question you've never asked them
detail: "What's a smell that makes you happy?"

title: Learn how to say "thank you" in a new language
detail: Then use it today.

title: Open a window and take ten slow breaths
detail: In through the nose, out like you're fogging a mirror.

title: Tidy one tiny space
detail: One drawer. One shelf. One corner.

title: Look at the sky for one whole minute
detail: Clouds, stars, blank blue — all good.

title: Compliment someone on something they chose
detail: Their playlist, their jacket, their idea.

title: Dance to one song, badly, on purpose
detail: No one is watching. Pip is cheering.

title: Make a tiny list of five things you like right now
detail: Fast. No thinking. Go.

title: Water a plant — or adopt one
detail: Even a basil from the shop counts.

title: Read one poem out loud
detail: Your voice deserves good words.

title: Take a photo of something ordinary that looks beautiful
detail: Light on a wall, steam from a cup.

title: Eat one piece of fruit slowly and properly
detail: Notice the first bite.

title: Write a two-line note to future you
detail: Or seal it in a capsule.

title: Hum while you do the dishes
detail: Dishes become a concert.

title: Do ten jumping jacks and laugh at yourself
detail: The laugh is the point.

title: Ask someone older about their favourite memory
detail: Then actually listen.

title: Draw Pip
detail: Wobbly is correct.

title: Look up why the sky is blue
detail: Rayleigh scattering is a delight.

title: Leave a kind review for a small shop or creator
detail: It makes their whole week.

title: Put your phone in another room for twenty minutes
detail: See what you reach for instead.

title: Find a word you love the sound of and say it three times
detail: Mellifluous. Mellifluous. Mellifluous.

title: Make your favourite warm drink and hold it with both hands
detail: That's it. That's the activity.

title: Write the names of three people who helped you this year
detail: Bonus: tell one of them.

title: Walk somewhere you've never walked before
detail: A new street, a new aisle, a new path.

title: Play one round of a Kairos game
detail: Word Bloom is waiting.

title: Fold a paper plane and throw it as far as you can
detail: Measure the flight. Beat it.

title: Write down a worry, then fold the paper in half
detail: Out of your head, onto the page.

title: Notice five sounds around you
detail: Near, far, loud, soft, surprising.

title: Cook or assemble something colourful
detail: Eat the rainbow, or at least three colours of it.

title: Learn one fun fact and tell someone
detail: Octopuses have three hearts.

title: Smile at your reflection like you mean it
detail: It's weird. Do it anyway.
